localCompositionSemantics: Digest of genuine captured index, store policy and backend descriptors only; actual object composition is fixed inside original index, but complete physical ArtifactPorts/v2 retention layout and tenant routing authority are not authenticated
limitations: Local prefix proofs and relative-key signatures do not authorize installation/root/routing pin, tenant-wide uniqueness, generation or business promotion
Caller storageGraphDigest is only compared between the two declarations; it is not returned as authenticated physical graph identity
localCompositionDigest does not expose or authenticate the complete ArtifactPorts layout and v2 segment/manifest authority configuration
The other genuine backend test has a different Ledger identity; a full same-identity/history physical clone rejection is not established
Same-process and independent-process append tests validate captured recheck after capture; there is no dedicated injection at the wrapper's last pre-return instruction
Final recheck verifies only five-field head and does not re-resolve all retained bytes; continuous artifact availability and a cross-file atomic snapshot are not proven
v2 verify/read may acquire maintenance locks or recover already-authorized migration/WAL/retained suffixes; this is not a physical open-only reader
A current authenticated v2 prefix does not prove migration permission at the historical acceptance time
Serializing or recomputing the result envelope does not create live verification or a trusted external authority; consumers must invoke the original index-backed verifier
No independent installation approval, protected highwater/pin, business router, authenticated producer, alias protocol or Registry release source gate was enabled
Local HMAC/manifest fixtures do not prove production key custody, external WORM, actual model/cost experiments, physical power-loss durability or Linux/macOS release checks
